answer.logline: Elias and Najm confront a reluctant harbour master to uncover a hidden truth in a decades-old logbook, sparking a new lead from the static of the sky.
answer.synopsis:
The morning after the mysterious signal, Elias and Najm visit the Kerran Point harbour office, a salt-worn outpost where the records of the 1987 storm are kept. They are met by Ingrid Dahl, the brisk and bureaucratic harbour master who views the tragedy of the Mariner as a closed chapter that should remain undisturbed.

While Elias’s frustration grows, Najm employs his librarian's patience, navigating Ingrid's rigid rules with gentle persistence. Eventually worn down, Ingrid grants them access to the sealed 1987 logbook. Inside, they discover a shocking discrepancy: the last radio entry from Ruth Moore indicates the Mariner turned back toward the point, contradicting the official inquiry's claim that the ship drifted out to sea.

Returning to the workshop in a state of quiet shock, the men wait as night falls. A new meteor shower streaks across the dark sky, and the old valve radio crackles to life once more. Through the static, a voice provides a specific bearing, pointing toward a location near the coast.

The episode closes on a poignant contrast: Elias, haunted by the sea and refusing to leave the shore, stares out the window at the horizon the bearing points to, while Najm unrolls a nautical chart to plot the coordinates.

design.build: Lean and rigid, standing as straight as a plumb line
design.face: Sharp, angular features with thin lips and a pointed chin
design.hair: Silver-grey hair pulled back into a tight, severe bun
design.skin: Pale, with a permanent wind-burn on her cheeks
distinguishing: A silver nautical whistle on a black lanyard around her neck
Perfectly pressed clothing despite the seaside humidity
design.wardrobe: A charcoal grey wool blazer over a crisp white button-down shirt, navy tailored trousers, and sensible black loafers
design.personality: Brisk, no-nonsense, and emotionally guarded; she believes order and rules prevent further tragedy

design.description: A small, salt-worn stone building perched on the edge of the harbour. The interior is a dense archive of nautical history, smelling of old paper, brine, and cold tea.
landmarks: A massive, scarred oak desk that dominates the center of the room
A wall of antique brass clocks showing different time zones
A heavy iron safe embedded in the back stone wall
Floor-to-ceiling wooden shelving filled with grey archival boxes
props: A heavy leather-bound logbook with '1987' embossed in gold

layout.architecture: Thick stone walls, low timber ceilings
entrances: A heavy wooden door leading to the wharf

scenes.title: The Approach
scenes.purpose: Establish the cold, imposing atmosphere of the office.
scenes.entryState: Elias and Najm walk up the wharf toward the office.
scenes.exitState: They stand before the heavy wooden door.

scenes.title: The Wall of Rules
scenes.purpose: Introduce Ingrid and her refusal to open the archives.
scenes.entryState: Elias and Najm enter; Ingrid is behind her desk, mid-stamp on a document.
scenes.exitState: Ingrid tells them the 1987 logs are sealed by order of the inquiry.

scenes.title: The Librarian's Tactic
scenes.purpose: Show Najm's ability to manipulate bureaucratic minds through patience.
scenes.entryState: Elias is pacing, agitated; Najm leans in, speaking softly about archival preservation.
scenes.exitState: Ingrid pauses, her rigid posture softening slightly.

scenes.title: The Iron Safe
scenes.purpose: The tension of accessing the forbidden record.
scenes.entryState: Ingrid sighs and walks to the heavy iron safe.
scenes.exitState: The safe door swings open with a heavy metallic groan.

scenes.title: The Truth in Ink
scenes.purpose: Reveal the discrepancy in the Mariner's last movements.
scenes.entryState: Najm carefully opens the leather logbook to the final page.
scenes.exitState: Close-up on the handwritten entry: 'Turning back toward the point'.

scenes.title: The Silent Departure
scenes.purpose: The realization that the official story was a lie.
scenes.entryState: Elias stares at the page, his bandaged hand trembling slightly.
scenes.exitState: They leave the office in a stunned silence; Ingrid watches them go, looking conflicted.

scenes.title: The Shadow of the Cliff
scenes.purpose: Transition from the discovery to the nightly wait.
scenes.entryState: Wide shot of the two small figures walking back toward the village under a purple sky.
scenes.exitState: They reach the door of Elias's workshop.

scenes.title: The Waiting Game
scenes.purpose: Build tension before the signal returns.
scenes.entryState: Elias is sitting by the radio; Najm is cleaning his glasses.
scenes.exitState: The first streak of a meteor passes the window.

scenes.title: The Sky Ignites
scenes.purpose: The return of the supernatural catalyst.
scenes.entryState: The window is filled with a flurry of falling stars.
scenes.exitState: The valve radio begins to hum and glow warm orange.

scenes.title: The Bearing
scenes.purpose: The radio provides a tangible lead.
scenes.entryState: Static screams, then a feminine voice cuts through: 'Bearing... zero-four-two...'.
scenes.exitState: The signal vanishes into static as the last meteor fades.

scenes.title: The Horizon
scenes.purpose: Highlight the emotional divide between the two men.
scenes.entryState: Elias stands at the window, looking at the black sea.
scenes.exitState: Cut to Najm unrolling a large nautical chart on the workbench, marking the bearing.
